en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a busy harbor packed with steamships and smaller boats moored along a quay. Cranes and scaffolding are visible across the water where shipbuilding or port construction is underway. The foreground features a large white passenger vessel, while cargo, crates, and sacks are stacked on the dock with workers walking about. Low hills and scattered buildings form the background. Printed text at the bottom identifies the location and publisher.
